rationale.text: The select sits in an element with role="form" instead of a form element, and each of its optgroups carries a label attribute. The criterion is asked of each form, and the glossary defines a form as a form tag or a tag with the WAI-ARIA role form, so this list is in a form. The custom check counts an ancestor with role form (step 1) and answers no_fault, so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only.

citations.quote: Balise <form> ou balise possédant un attribut WAI-ARIA role="form".
Dans chaque balise `<select>`, chaque balise `<optgroup>` possède-t-elle un attribut `label` ?
